title: Async Todo List with Server Sync
description: Build a todo list that syncs with a mock server, handling async add/delete operations, optimistic updates, and rollback on errors.
requirements: Show 'Loading todos...' with class 'loading' during initial data fetch
Display an h1 with text 'Async Todo List'
Show an error banner with class 'error-banner' when errors occur
Error banner should display the error message and have a 'Dismiss' button to clear it
Include a form with text input (placeholder: 'Add a new todo') and submit button
Submit button should show 'Adding...' when submitting, 'Add' otherwise
Input and button should be disabled while submitting
Display todos in a ul with class 'todo-list'
Each todo should be an li with class 'todo-item' containing the text and Delete button
Implement optimistic updates: add todo to UI immediately before server confirms
Rollback the optimistic add if server returns error (restore input text)
Implement optimistic delete: remove from UI immediately
Rollback the optimistic delete if server returns error
Load todos on component mount using the api.fetchTodos function
Handle TypeScript types properly for Todo interface
Prevent empty todos from being added (trim input)

hints.state: You need: todos array, loading boolean, error string, input string, and submitting boolean
hints.optimistic: Add todo to state immediately, then replace with server response (or rollback on error)
hints.rollback: Store the item before deleting, so you can restore it if the server call fails
hints.form: Use e.preventDefault() in handleAdd and check input.trim() before adding
hints.errors: Set error state in catch blocks, clear it on success or when user dismisses
